subject: bryn-eriksson
label: The cuddle bus — Sleipnir, or The Fuck Wagon
to: The cuddle bus, bought in Arc 3
note: Bryn bought it to move her people around in comfort, which is the most Bryn purchase in the ledger — a hearth with wheels, built for piling in. She named it SLEIPNIR, after her own spirit animal, and never explained it to anyone. Torie christened it THE FUCK WAGON and that name stuck to it harder than the one Bryn gave it. Both names are canon; only one of them gets said in front of guests. See c-sleipnir: the Archive held Torie's name slightly wrong and never recorded Bryn's at all.
